definitions.wellDefined:

  copulas x →

definitions.name: rho

definitions.wellDefined:
∀ (x : I → I → ℝ),
  copulas x →
    (∀ (x : I), 0 ≤ 1 - ↑x ∧ 1 - ↑x ≤ 1) ∧
      integrable fun x_2 => x x_2 x_2 + x x_2 (Set.projIcc 0 1 ⋯ (1 - ↑x_2))
definitions.name: gamma

      (rho x_2 = x →
        copulas x_2)
